item.title: U17 REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Brentford FC (PDL Shield)
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-17s run in the PDL Shield came to an end after they were defeated 2-0 at home to Brentford in the Semi-Final. The PDL Shield is an affiliate competition of the PDL Cup, with the young Red Dragons securing a 4-2 victory over Cardiff City last month to reach this stage of the competition. The visitors broke the deadlock in the 26th minute as Beau Redknapp's low effort found the bottom corner, and they secured their place in the Final when Jai Nwosu converted late into proceedings

item.title: TOUR 2026 | Wrexham AFC to return to the US to play three matches
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce the Red Dragons will be returning to the United States as part of our 2026 summer tour with three matches on the East Coast. The Red Dragons will be returning Stateside for the third time, and first since 2024, and will play exclusively against current Premier League sides – Liverpool, Leeds United and Sunderland AFC. The Wrexham AFC in the USA 2026 tour starts in Florida, where Wrexham will face Leeds at the Raymond James Stadium in Tampa on Saturday July 2

item.title: U15 REPORT | Wrexham AFC 3-0 Carlisle United
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-15s booked their place in the Semi-Finals of the Floodlit Cup as they secured a 3-0 win over Carlisle United at Central Park, the home of Denbigh Town. The young Red Dragon won their group phase, securing victories over Bolton Wanderers and Oldham Athletic and drawing against Stockport County, with their only loss coming against Crewe Alexandra.
